title: Synthesis, structure and magnetic properties of a novel Tb4 spin cluster and synthesis of a Tb chain

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, Tb(OAc)3·H2O (0.68 g, 2.0 mmol) and H4L (0.46 g, 2.0 mmol) were dissolved in MeOH (50 cm3) and stirred overnight. The white precipitate was removed by filtration; the filtrate was evaporated to dryness and redissolved in a minimum of MeOH. After two days, a mixture of crystals of 1 and 2 was filtered off and the remaining yellow solution was layered with Et2O. After a further three days, pale yellow plate-shaped crystals of 1·2Et2O formed. The crystals were isolated and washed with minimum MeOH and Et2O (25% yield). A crystallographic sample was kept in contact with mother liquor to prevent loss of interstitial solvent.
synthesis.time: stirred overnight; crystals of mixed 1 and 2 after two days; 1·2Et2O after a further three days of Et2O layering
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic stirring, filtration, evaporation, MeOH recrystallization, Et2O layering
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: White precipitate filtered off; filtrate evaporated and redissolved in minimum MeOH; mixed crystals filtered off; yellow solution layered with Et2O to give pale yellow plates of 1·2Et2O, washed with minimum MeOH and Et2O.

properties.summary: Magnetism of 1·Et2O is dominated by ligand-field splitting of the 7F6 states of two crystallographically distinct Tb(III) ions, with a possible weak antiferromagnetic contribution at the lowest temperatures. Room-temperature χT is 44.4 emu mol−1 K (below the free-ion 47.3 emu mol−1 K). χT decreases below ~100 K; AC and 0.1 T DC χT curves overlay, so the drop is not an applied-field artifact. Magnetization at 2 K and 5 T is 19.3 NμB and unsaturated, well below 36 NμB. No out-of-phase AC signal down to 1.8 K (no SMM behavior).

measurements.conditions: room temperature; randomly oriented polycrystalline sample restrained in eicosane; SQUID

measurements.name: magnetization M
measurements.conditions: 2 K, 5 T; isothermal magnetization; not saturated

measurements.name: out-of-phase AC susceptibility
measurements.conditions: AC field 3×10−4 T, frequencies 10–10^3 Hz, down to 1.8 K

synthesis.procedure: Prepared under the same aerobic reaction conditions as 1: Tb(OAc)3·H2O (0.68 g, 2.0 mmol) and H4L (0.46 g, 2.0 mmol) in MeOH (50 cm3), stirred overnight, filtrate concentrated. Needle-shaped crystals of 2 were manually isolated from the mixture of crystals formed from the concentrated methanolic solution. A pure bulk sample could not be obtained because crystallization also produced 1; a crystallographic sample was kept in contact with mother liquor.

reagents.name: 2-((2-hydroxy-benzylidene)-amino)-2-hydroxymethyl-propane-1,3-diol
reagents.role: present in the reaction mixture (not incorporated in 2)

synthesis.time: overnight stirring; crystals from concentrated MeOH after two days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: same aerobic MeOH reaction as 1; manual isolation of needles
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Needle crystals of 2 isolated by hand from a mixed crystalline crop; no pure bulk sample for physical measurements.
